# restate_subscription (Resource)

A subscription that drives a Restate handler from a Kafka topic.

The Admin API has no update operation for subscriptions, so **every change replaces** the subscription. Replacement briefly stops consumption; the new subscription resumes from whatever offset its `options` specify.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The Admin API has no update operation for subscriptions, so every change replaces this resource.
# Replacement briefly stops consumption and resumes from whatever offset `options` specifies.

resource "restate_subscription" "orders" {
  source = "kafka://${restate_kafka_cluster.orders.name}/orders"
  sink   = "service://${data.restate_service.order_service.name}/handleOrder"

  options = {
    "auto.offset.reset" = "earliest"
    "group.id"          = "restate-orders"
  }
}

resource "restate_kafka_cluster" "orders" {
  name = "orders-cluster"

  properties = {
    "bootstrap.servers" = "broker-1.kafka.example.com:9092"
  }
}

# Referencing the service through a data source makes the ordering explicit: a subscription's sink
# must name a service that deployment discovery has already found.
data "restate_service" "order_service" {
  name = "OrderService"

  depends_on = [restate_deployment.orders]
}

resource "restate_deployment" "orders" {
  http = {
    uri = "https://orders.internal.example.com:9080"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `sink` (String) Handler to invoke, as `service://<service>/<handler>`.

Changing it replaces the subscription.
- `source` (String) Kafka topic to consume, as `kafka://<cluster>/<topic>`, where `<cluster>` is a `restate_kafka_cluster` name.

Changing it replaces the subscription. A scheme this provider's pinned contract does not document is sent unchanged with a warning, rather than rejected, so a newer Restate server's scheme is not blocked by the provider.

### Optional

- `options` (Map of String) Consumer options, such as `auto.offset.reset`. Passed through to the Kafka consumer as strings.

Changing them replaces the subscription.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Subscription ID assigned by Restate, for example `sub_1a2b3c`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import restate_subscription.orders sub_1a2b3c
```
